# headscale-gui — static build

Ready-to-serve files of [headscale-gui](https://github.com/tjunussov/headscale-gui) (Headscale VPN web UI for Headscale 0.28), built automatically from `main`. Nothing to install or compile: put the `admin/` folder on a web server next to Headscale.

```bash
# first time
git clone -b static --depth 1 https://github.com/tjunussov/headscale-gui /srv/headscale-gui
# update later
git -C /srv/headscale-gui pull
```

No git? Download the branch as a ZIP from GitHub, or `headscale-gui-admin.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/tjunussov/headscale-gui/releases).

Serve it on the Headscale domain under `/admin` (same origin = no CORS). Unknown `/admin/...` paths must fall back to `admin/200.html`.

**Caddy**
```caddyfile
headscale.example.com {
    handle /admin* {
        root * /srv/headscale-gui
        try_files {path} {path}.html {path}/index.html /admin/200.html
        file_server
    }
    reverse_proxy localhost:8080
}
```

**nginx**
```nginx
location /admin/ {
    root /srv/headscale-gui;
    try_files $uri $uri.html $uri/index.html /admin/200.html;
}
```

Then open `https://headscale.example.com/admin/` → Settings, leave API URL empty, paste a key from `headscale apikeys create --expiration 90d`.

Built for the `/admin` path. Other paths: build from source with `ENDPOINT=/your-path npm run build`. Docker image: `ghcr.io/tjunussov/headscale-gui`. This branch is generated by CI — don't edit it; changes go to `main`.
